messages:
sara: Quick sync — pilot readiness check for the adaptive recommendations pilot (batching + quant recs + eval-triggered alerts). Need to lock launch gates and minimal acceptance criteria.
rohit: Short version: ACMEHealth wants measurable cost wins without production regressions. What's the narrowest set of gates we can promise for a beta?
maya: From evaluation: propose these thresholds as a starting point — per-slice and population checks.
- population avg quality delta >= -1% relative to baseline
- per-prompt regression rate < 2% (i.e., <2% of prompts drop by > 5% qual)
- concordance on intent labels >= 98% of baseline
(we'll map to concrete metrics per customer)
eli: Ops constraints: must meet p99 latency < 350ms on hosted beta traffic and token-cost reduction >= 15% on pilot load. Rollback must be possible within 5 minutes. Also require audit logs and trace IDs.
jess: Customer asks: non-negotiable are rollback within minutes, visibility into which requests used quant/ batching, and a simple opt-out switch for customers during pilot. Also we need acceptance signoff flow for CS.
rohit: Engineering plan: support canary routing + automatic fallback to non-quant model on quality regressions. PR #4820 implements routing weights and a canary header. Config snippet for routing: 
```
routing:
  - weight: 10
    model: mx-quant-8
  - weight: 90
    model: mx-fp16
```
We still need prefix cache metrics exposed in the console.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled in staging for 2025-03-05 16:00 UTC (queued).
sara: Action items recap (owners):
1) eval suite + per-customer slices (maya)
2) rollback runbook + alerting rules (eli)
3) customer-facing pilot notes + acceptance checklist (jess)
4) gating matrix + config for canary weights (rohit/sara)
Timeline proposal: pilot beta in ~3 weeks; canary start next Tue if no blockers. Objections?
maya: I'll deliver an eval harness + threshold table by EOD Tue. Will include ACME-specific slices and sample fail cases.
eli: I'll draft rollback runbook and add three alerting rules: token-cost-savings, p99-latency, quality-regressions. Will wire them into the console and add a playbook test run.
jess: I'll prepare pilot notes and an acceptance signoff doc for ACMEHealth; will ask them to enable synthetic traffic for the first 48h.
rohit: One open dev question: acceptable fallback policy when prefix caching increases P95 (we sometimes see warm-cache regressions). I propose immediate fallback to warm-fp16 variant for affected route + emit anomaly tag.
sara: That sounds right. Final gating checklist for green: (a) eval thresholds pass on ACME data, (b) rollback runbook tested end-to-end, (c) CS briefed + customer opt-out ready, (d) SLOs met on staging (latency/cost). If all green, beta launch at 10% traffic with 2-week observation window.
deploy-bot: reminder: runbook template available at /docs/runbooks/pilot-rollback.md (stub — please populate).
rohit: No blockers from eng other than the prefix-metrics expose. We'll scope that to a single dashboard tile for the pilot.
sara: Great — I'll pull this into the roadmap milestone and ping stakeholders. If you can drop ETA comments on the checklist doc, I'll lock dates later today. Thanks all!
